'''Typhon''' was a group of four [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|escort shuttles]] that were used by the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] during the [[Sepan Civil War]].

==History==
Used by the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] during the [[Sepan Civil War]], the Escort shuttles participated in the [[Second battle of the Sepan system|Second Battle of the Sepan system]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sepan campaign|campaign]] led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] to pacify the war. During the battle, Ripoblus [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], consisting of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] in a stolen [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft|System patrol craft]] [[Glas]], and [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] in two [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] [[Nazaar]]. The Ripoblus had been trying to intercept the fleeing refugees with the [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] forces not far behind. However Harkov granted asylum to refugees and escorted the ships to the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory class destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|Protector]]. By the time the Escort Shuttles had arrived Glas had docked with the Protector and the scientists were on board, the ship was then sent on autopilot to drift of into space. The Shuttles were intercepted and with the help of the Protector's turbolasers and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]], one of which piloted by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], all 4 of the shuttles were destroyed.
